d: Short, straight ash-blonde hair with blunt-cut bangs and vibrant cyan highlights at the nape. Sharp, narrow red eyes with a focused, stern expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender, athletic build wearing a white military-style coat with black trim and fur-lined cuffs over a short white tunic, paired with thigh-high black stockings and grey boots. A large, tattered deep red cape flows from the back, accompanied by a massive, mechanical grey cannon floating behind.
